hypothesis: The persistent unexplained work across all six shape/cache states suggests runtime variability. Replacing the boundary correction with garbage-collector entry state tests whether allocation history explains that variation.

pcvs.name: latent_volume
pcvs.rationale: Captures the dominant spatial scaling of decoder operations.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * x.shape[2] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4] if feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None else 0
pcvs.name: cached_latent_volume
pcvs.rationale: Captures the additional volume-dependent work from temporal upsampling on cached chunks.

pcvs.expression: int(feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None)
pcvs.name: has_cached_features
pcvs.rationale: Separates fixed overhead for initial and cached chunks.

pcvs.name: gc_allocation_balance
pcvs.rationale: Cheap runtime entry state that may explain allocation and garbage-collection variability within otherwise identical decoder shapes.
